injuries.name: Josh Oliver
injuries.headline: Josh Oliver (biceps) placed on IR
injuries.comment: Oliver was slated to undergo surgery. He will miss at least the next four games.

injuries.name: Jalen Davis
injuries.headline: Jalen Davis placed on IR
injuries.comment: Davis injured his hamstring in Sunday’s loss to the Steelers. He will miss at least the next four games.

injuries.name: Jackson Slater
injuries.headline: Jackson Slater placed on IR
injuries.comment: Slater will miss at least the next four weeks.

injuries.name: Fernando Carmona Jr.
injuries.headline: Fernando Carmona Jr. (ankle) placed on IR
injuries.comment: Carmona will miss at least the next four weeks.

injuries.name: Kamren Kinchens
injuries.headline: Kamren Kinchens (hamstring) hopeful to return in Week 4
injuries.comment: Kinchens is working his way back from a hamstring injury.

injuries.name: Jalen McMillan
injuries.headline: Jalen McMillan (knee) placed on IR
injuries.comment: McMillan underwent an MRI that confirmed a PCL sprain. He is expected to miss 6-to-8 weeks.

injuries.name: Rico Dowdle
injuries.headline: Rico Dowdle (toe) listed as 'DNP' on Monday’s estimated practice report
injuries.comment: Dowdle was sidelined this past week. He is likely to remain sidelined for the Steelers on a short week against the Browns. Jaylen Warren would remain the clear lead back for Pittsburgh.

injuries.name: Elgton Jenkins
injuries.headline: Elgton Jenkins (concussion) listed as DNP on Monday's practice report
injuries.comment: It is a short week for Cleveland playing its division rival Steelers on Thursday. The status of Jenkins will need to be monitored the next couple of days.

injuries.name: Teven Jenkins
injuries.headline: Teven Jenkins (back) listed as DNP on Monday's estimated practice report
injuries.comment: It is a short week for Cleveland playing its division rival Steelers on Thursday. The status of Jenkins will need to be monitored the next couple of days.

injuries.name: Terrance Ferguson
injuries.headline: Terrance Ferguson (ankle) to likely miss Week 4
injuries.comment: Ferguson left Sunday's game against the Broncos. He did return, but then left again after making one catch. With Colby Parkinson also banged up, Tyler Higbee could be in line for a bigger role.

injuries.name: Romello Height
injuries.headline: Romello Height (hand) hopeful to return in Week 4
injuries.comment: Height was sidelined this past week after going down with a hand injury. His status will need to be monitored in practice throughout the week.

injuries.name: Jalen Coker
injuries.headline: Jalen Coker (quad) out for the remainder of Week 3
injuries.comment: Coker was questionable to play today but that was due to an ankle injury. Coker has now picked up a new injury and will not return. He will finish the day with 18 receiving yards on two receptions.

injuries.name: Ollie Gordon II
injuries.headline: Ollie Gordon II (cramping) questionable to return
injuries.comment: Gordon jogged off to the locker room and is now officially questionable to return. This is a big blow to the Dolphins' offense with De'Von Achane (knee) already ruled out.

injuries.name: Rachaad White
injuries.headline: Rachaad White (shoulder) questionable to return
injuries.comment: White had four rushing yards on two carries and one receptions for six yards prior to the injury. Jacory Croskey-Merritt will continue to see the bulk of the carries with White sidelined.

injuries.name: Michael Pittman Jr.
injuries.headline: Michael Pittman Jr. (foot) expected to play on Sunday against Cincy
injuries.comment: Pittman should give Aaron Rodgers a reliable possession receiver over the middle of the field, opening things up for the offense. Germie Bernard tried to play that role last week, but didn’t quite have the same fluidity as Pittman. He should be a decent WR3 with upside.

injuries.name: P.J. Locke
injuries.headline: P.J. Locke (foot) placed on IR
injuries.comment: Locke will miss at least the next four games.

injuries.name: Caleb Williams
injuries.headline: Caleb Williams (hamstring) ruled out Monday
injuries.comment: Williams was never expected to play this week after going down with his injury last week. It will be Tyson Bagent or Case Keenum starting on Monday.

injuries.name: Jonah Coleman
injuries.headline: Jonah Coleman (ankle) placed on IR
injuries.comment: Coleman had already been ruled out for this week's game. He will now miss at least the next four games. J.K. Dobbins and RJ Harvey will continue to lead the Broncos backfield.

injuries.name: DeVonta Smith
injuries.headline: DeVonta Smith (hamstring) cleared for Week 3
injuries.comment: Smith is good to go for head coach Nick Sirianni after logging practice sessions on back-to-back days to end the week while battling a lingering hamstring injury, offering quarterback Jalen Hurts is primary pass-catching target against a shaky Bears secondary Monday night.

injuries.name: Saquon Barkley
injuries.headline: Saquon Barkley (stinger) off injury report for Eagles
injuries.comment: Barkley is good to go after logging full practice sessions to end the week for head coach Nick Sirianni, boosting a Philadelphia rushing attack that will look to take advantage of a susceptible Bears defense Monday night.

injuries.name: Ryan Miller
injuries.headline: Ryan Miller (hip/back) officially questionable for Sunday
injuries.comment: Miller is uncertain to play on Sunday. He's dealing with a pair of injuries right now and is likely considered day-to-day as a result. If he's cleared to play, he will see more work than usual with Caleb Douglas (ankle) set to be sidelined against the Chiefs.

injuries.name: Chris Bell
injuries.headline: Chris Bell (knee) good to go for Sunday
injuries.comment: The rookie will be available to play on Sunday after being limited at practice earlier in the week due to a knee issue of some kind. Expect him to see even more work with Caleb Douglas (ankle) set to be sidelined against the Chiefs this week.

injuries.name: Mansoor Delane
injuries.headline: Mansoor Delane (shoulder) will play Sunday
injuries.comment: The rookie will be available to play on Sunday, despite dealing with a shoulder injury throughout the week at practice. Kansas City's defense projects to be a great fantasy option this week in an easy matchup against the Dolphins.

injuries.name: L'Jarius Sneed
injuries.headline: L'Jarius Sneed (knee) cleared to play Sunday
injuries.comment: The veteran was limited at practice all week due to a knee injury, but he has been cleared to play and should be good to go against the Dolphins this week. He will continue to play an important role on Kansas City's stellar defense for the foreseeable future.

injuries.name: Josh Simmons
injuries.headline: Josh Simmons (back) ruled out for Sunday
injuries.comment: Simmons is set to miss yet another game on Sunday due to his nagging back injury. Rookie Kahlil Benson will likely continue to start in the place of the absent veteran for the foreseeable future.

injuries.name: Ronnie Stanley
injuries.headline: Ronnie Stanley (toe) won't play Sunday
injuries.comment: The veteran is going to be sidelined in Week 3. He's dealing with a toe injury of some kind right now, and it's unclear whether or not it will cause him to miss more time beyond this game. Baltimore's offense may struggle a bit more without their starting left tackle in a matchup against the Cowboys this week.

injuries.name: Trey Hendrickson
injuries.headline: Trey Hendrickson (finger) good to go for Sunday
injuries.comment: Baltimore's star edge rusher will be available to play on Sunday, despite being on the injury report all week due to a lingering finger issue. The team will need him to step up in a tough matchup against Dallas' high-powered offense this week.
